motion.local: LOCAL FILES. READY FOR THE WEB.
motion.androidBody: Unpack Motion Photos into the original JPG and MP4. Batch processing, entirely in your browser.
motion.iosBody: Turn unmodified Live Photo originals into matching JPG + H.264 MP4 assets for the web.
motion.androidNote: The original image and video bytes are preserved. Playback depends on the embedded codec.
motion.iosNote: Web derivatives, not Apple Live Photo archives. HEIC metadata, HDR and auxiliary images are not preserved. Max 100 MB per file / 50 MP per HEIC.
motion.offline: Files stay on this device. Conversion engines load on first use; offline use requires that they have been cached.
motion.pairing: Pairing uses matching filenames. Import both files together. Unmatched images or videos can be converted separately; duplicate names need to be resolved before processing.
motion.lockedHint: Results are kept. Start a new batch to process more files; this clears the current queue and results.

errors.ambiguous: Multiple files share this name. Clear the batch and choose one matching pair.
errors.invalidMotion: No valid appended MP4 was found in this JPEG. Photos saved or forwarded through chat or social apps usually have their motion data stripped — use the original file from the camera app.
errors.invalidHeic: Unable to decode this HEIC image.
errors.tooManyPixels: HEIC exceeds the 50 megapixel safety limit.
errors.tooLarge: A source file exceeds the 100 MB limit.
errors.timeout: Conversion timed out. Retry with a smaller source.
errors.engineFailed: The local conversion engine failed. Check available memory and connection for the first engine load, then retry.
errors.videoFailed: Video conversion failed. Retry with a smaller source.
errors.cancelled: Cancelled. You can retry this item.
errors.exportFailed: ZIP export failed. Try individual downloads or a smaller batch.
errors.batchLimit: Use at most 100 files and {{maxMB}} MB of sources per batch.

motion.previewUnavailable: This browser cannot preview this video codec. The exported file is available to download.
